final: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cnt), 0) AS sum_group_counts, AVG(1.0 * cnt / total) AS average_share, AVG(1.0 * cnt / total - average_share) AS average_excess FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS total FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id) AS grouped CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(1.0 * cnt / total) AS average_share FROM (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS total FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id)) AS overall WHERE 1.0 * cnt / total > average_share
